blocks.translation:
• Warning — To customers: Read this before use.
• This product is for ages 15 and over. Do not give it to children under 15.
• Read the online instruction manual.
• This product contains small parts. Keep away from young children to prevent accidental swallowing and choking.
• Some parts are pointed or sharp. Handle and store carefully to avoid unexpected injury.
• Do not use near the ear. Accidental use may damage hearing.
• This product contains electronic components; people with pacemakers should take care.
• Keep fingers, hair, and clothing away from rotating parts.
• Do not put fingers into gaps of moving parts; they may be pinched and cause injury.
• Do not stare at flashing LED lights; this may cause discomfort or illness.
• Incorrect battery use can cause overheating, rupture, or leakage. Observe the following:
• Do not use rechargeable (secondary) batteries.
• Do not mix old and new batteries or different types of batteries.
• Install batteries with the correct +/− polarity.
• After use, always turn off the switch and remove the batteries. Leaving batteries installed may cause leakage and is dangerous.
• Do not short-circuit, charge, disassemble, heat, or throw batteries into fire.
• If battery fluid gets into the eyes, rinse immediately with plenty of water and consult a physician. If it contacts skin or clothing, wash with water.
• When disposing of batteries, follow your local government's waste disposal instructions.

●本商品は精密に作られています。無理な力を加えたり、落としたりすると破損する恐れがあります。 本商品は精密な電子部品で構成
されています。落としたり、水に濡らしたり、汚したり、分解したりしないでください。 また、高温・低温になるところでの使用、保管は避けて
ください。●プラスチック梱包材は、 開封後はすぐに捨ててください。 ●本商品には塗装部分がありますので、 保管の際には他のもの
(樹脂製品や家具、ソファー)と接触しないようにしてください。 色が移る場合があります。●可動部分・取付部分を無理な方向に強く
引っ張ったり、曲げたりしないでください。 発音の一部にイントネーションが違っていたり、 商品の特性上聞き取りにくいものがありますが、
ご了承ください。●オージャカリバー -MEMORIAL EDITION -には、対応しているMEMOREALIZE DATA CARD以外をセット
しないでください。故障や破損の原因となります。
blocks.translation:
• This product is made with precise components. Applying excessive force or dropping it may cause damage.
• This product contains delicate electronic parts. Do not drop it, get it wet, soil it, or disassemble it. Also avoid using or storing it where it will become very hot or very cold.
• Discard plastic packaging materials immediately after opening.
• This product has painted surfaces. When storing it, keep it from contacting other items (plastic products, furniture, sofas), as color transfer may occur.
• Do not strongly pull or bend movable or attached parts in unnatural directions.
• Some spoken lines have different intonation or may be hard to hear because of the product's characteristics.
• For Oja Caliber -MEMORIAL EDITION-, do not insert any MEMOREALIZE DATA CARD other than the supported cards. Doing so may cause malfunction or damage.

順番
セリフ
モード切替音王様戦隊キングオージャー

これは平和を守る王たちの物語。 そして、王になる男の物語である。
blocks.translation:
• Chikyuu, a planet at the edge of space. A great crisis is looming over this world, which is ruled by five kingdoms.
• This is the story of the kings who protect peace, and the story of the man who will become king.

blocks.text: でも・・・僕は・・・王様じゃない。
何ふ抜けてんだタコメンチ。
blocks.translation: What are you spacing out for, Takomenchi?

blocks.text: いつもなんちゃらの王だののたまってただろうが。
blocks.translation: You were always going around saying you were some kind of king, weren't you?

blocks.text: 王と名乗れば王。 ワガママを通せばいいじゃない。
blocks.translation: If you call yourself a king, you're a king. Why not just go ahead and have your way?

blocks.text: 相手が守護神であろうと欺いてやればいいのです。
blocks.translation: Just deceive them, even if your opponent is a guardian deity.

blocks.text: 民を守るためだ罪には問わない。
blocks.translation: It was to protect the people. You will not be charged with a crime.

blocks.text: 聞こえるか?守護神!
その伝説の力この邪悪の王に差し出せ!
blocks.translation: Offer that legendary power to this evil king!

blocks.text: 俺様が世界を支配する!
一に王二に王三四が王で五にも王!
blocks.translation: One is king, two is king, three and four are king, and five is king too!

blocks.text: 序列無く異なる高みを極めし英傑!
blocks.translation: Heroes who, with no ranking, have each reached different heights!

blocks.text: 不倶戴天の仲なれど民の為今交わらん!
blocks.translation: We may be mortal enemies, but for the people we will join forces now!

blocks.text: 孤高を捨て連帯し 王冠を戴く戦士となる!
blocks.translation: Give up solitude and unite—become a crown-bearing warrior!

blocks.text: 降臨せよ!レジェンドキングオージャー!
さぁ、奇跡を起こしてやろうじゃないか!
blocks.translation: Now, let's make a miracle happen!

これは平和を守る王たちの物語。 そして、 反逆の戦士たちの物語である。
blocks.translation:
• Chikyū, a planet at the edge of the universe. A great crisis is threatening this world ruled by six kingdoms.
• This is the story of the kings who protect peace. It is also the story of the rebel warriors.

blocks.text: 我々は新たに世界を脅かす敵が到来した時に備え
blocks.translation: We prepare for the arrival of a new enemy that threatens the world.

blocks.text: 国境を超え、利害を排除し、国同士が一丸となって、敵を打ち倒すため新たな組織を結成した。
blocks.translation: A new organization was formed to cross borders, eliminate vested interests, and unite nations to defeat the enemy.

blocks.text: 五王国、異様事案対策用戦略救命部隊。
blocks.translation: Five Kingdoms Strategic Rescue Unit for Unusual Incident Response.

blocks.text: 通称は、守護神の名に由来し･･･。 王様戦隊キングオージャーとする。
blocks.translation: The common name is derived from the guardian deity's name... It will be called King Sentai King-Oger.

blocks.text: 降臨せよ!エクストリームキングオージャー!
俺は媚びねぇ、へつらわねぇ。誰が相手になろうとも、意地とドタマでブッチギる。
blocks.translation:
• I won't flatter or grovel.
• No matter who stands in my way, I'll smash them with my pride and my head.

blocks.text: それが、ンコンパ総長、ヤンマ・ガストだ。
blocks.translation: That is Commander Nkonpa, Yanma Gast.

blocks.text: 我が名はイシャバーナの女王ヒメノ・ラン。
blocks.translation: My name is Himeno Ran, queen of Ishabana.

blocks.text: ただ我がままに我が道をゆく!散ることを知らぬ花･･･。 その気高きを知るがよい!
blocks.translation:
• I follow my own selfish path!
• A flower that never falls... Know its nobility!

blocks.text: 民とは命なり。民のためには、 泥に塗れて手を汚す。
blocks.translation:
• The people are life.
• For the sake of the people, I will get my hands dirty in the mud.

blocks.text: それが豊穣の大殿様 カグラギ・ディボウスキ。
blocks.translation: That is the Great Lord of Abundance, Kaguragi Dibouski.

blocks.text: 法とは王を穿つ矛。 法とは民を守る盾。 なればこそ、ゴッカンは不動なり。
blocks.translation:

blocks.text: 地が裂け天が降ろうともこのリタ・カニスカは揺るがない!
blocks.translation: Even if the earth splits and the heavens fall, this Rita Kaniska will not be shaken!

blocks.text: 俺は、ジェラミー・イドモナラク・ネ・ブラシエリ。
blocks.translation: I am Jeremy Idomonaraku ne Brashieri.

blocks.text: 人、バグナラク、全てを統べて、世界の運命を定める狭間の王様、
blocks.translation: The Rift King who rules over humans and Bugnarak and determines the fate of the world,

blocks.text: その有様を、永久に語り継ぐといい!
blocks.translation: Keep telling the story of what happened forever!

blocks.text: 恐怖しろ! そしておののけ! 一切の情け容赦なく一木一草ことごとく!
blocks.translation: Be terrified! And tremble! Without any pity or mercy whatsoever, spare not a single tree or blade of grass!

blocks.text: 王様戦隊キングオージャー!

地が裂け天が降ろうともこのリタ・カニスカは揺るがない!

人、バグナラク、全てを統べて、世界の運命を定める狭間の王様、

恐怖しろ! そしておののけ! 一切の情け容赦なく一木一草ことごとく!

6.translation:
• Chikyuu, a planet at the edge of space. A great crisis is looming over this world, which is ruled by five kingdoms.
• This is the story of the kings who protect peace, and the story of the man who will become king.

rows.text:
宇宙の片隅の惑星チキュー。5つの王国が治めるこの星に巨大な危機が迫っている。
これは平和を守る王たちの物語。 そして、王になる男の物語である。
rows.translation: Chikyuu, a planet at the edge of space. A great crisis is looming over this world, which is ruled by five kingdoms. This is the story of the kings who protect peace, and the story of the man who will become king.

rows.text: でも・・・僕は・・・王様じゃない。

8.translation: What are you spacing out for, Takomenchi?

rows.text: 何ふ抜けてんだタコメンチ。
rows.translation: What are you spacing out for, Takomenchi?

9.translation: You were always going around saying you were some kind of king, weren't you?

rows.text: いつもなんちゃらの王だののたまってただろうが。
rows.translation: You were always going around saying you were some kind of king, weren't you?

10.translation: If you call yourself a king, you're a king. Why not just go ahead and have your way?

rows.text: 王と名乗れば王。 ワガママを通せばいいじゃない。
rows.translation: If you call yourself a king, you're a king. Why not just go ahead and have your way?

11.translation: Just deceive them, even if your opponent is a guardian deity.

rows.text: 相手が守護神であろうと欺いてやればいいのです。
rows.translation: Just deceive them, even if your opponent is a guardian deity.

12.translation: It was to protect the people. You will not be charged with a crime.

rows.text: 民を守るためだ罪には問わない。
rows.translation: It was to protect the people. You will not be charged with a crime.

14.translation: Offer that legendary power to this evil king!

rows.text: その伝説の力この邪悪の王に差し出せ!
rows.translation: Offer that legendary power to this evil king!

rows.text: 俺様が世界を支配する!

16.translation: One is king, two is king, three and four are king, and five is king too!

rows.text: 一に王二に王三四が王で五にも王!
rows.translation: One is king, two is king, three and four are king, and five is king too!

17.translation: Heroes who, with no ranking, have each reached different heights!

rows.text: 序列無く異なる高みを極めし英傑!
rows.translation: Heroes who, with no ranking, have each reached different heights!

18.translation: We may be mortal enemies, but for the people we will join forces now!

rows.text: 不倶戴天の仲なれど民の為今交わらん!
rows.translation: We may be mortal enemies, but for the people we will join forces now!

19.translation: Give up solitude and unite—become a crown-bearing warrior!

rows.text: 孤高を捨て連帯し 王冠を戴く戦士となる!
rows.translation: Give up solitude and unite—become a crown-bearing warrior!

rows.text: 降臨せよ!レジェンドキングオージャー!

21.translation: Now, let's make a miracle happen!

rows.text: さぁ、奇跡を起こしてやろうじゃないか!
rows.translation: Now, let's make a miracle happen!

rows.text: キングオージャー(後期) モード
モード切替音 キングオージャー!

27.translation:
• Chikyū, a planet at the edge of the universe. A great crisis is threatening this world ruled by six kingdoms.
• This is the story of the kings who protect peace. It is also the story of the rebel warriors.

rows.text:
宇宙の片隅の惑星 チキュー。6つの王国が治めるこの星に巨大な危機が迫っている。
これは平和を守る王たちの物語。 そして、 反逆の戦士たちの物語である。
rows.translation: Chikyū, a planet at the edge of the universe. A great crisis is threatening this world ruled by six kingdoms. This is the story of the kings who protect peace. It is also the story of the rebel warriors.

28.translation: We prepare for the arrival of a new enemy that threatens the world.

rows.text: 我々は新たに世界を脅かす敵が到来した時に備え
rows.translation: We prepare for the arrival of a new enemy that threatens the world.

30.translation: Five Kingdoms Strategic Rescue Unit for Unusual Incident Response.

rows.text: 五王国、異様事案対策用戦略救命部隊。
rows.translation: Five Kingdoms Strategic Rescue Unit for Unusual Incident Response.

31.translation: The common name is derived from the guardian deity's name... It will be called King Sentai King-Oger.

rows.text: 通称は、守護神の名に由来し･･･。 王様戦隊キングオージャーとする。
rows.translation: The common name is derived from the guardian deity's name... It will be called King Sentai King-Oger.

rows.text: 降臨せよ!エクストリームキングオージャー!

33.translation:
• I won't flatter or grovel.
• No matter who stands in my way, I'll smash them with my pride and my head.

rows.text: 俺は媚びねぇ、へつらわねぇ。誰が相手になろうとも、意地とドタマでブッチギる。
rows.translation: I won't flatter or grovel. No matter who stands in my way, I'll smash them with my pride and my head.

34.translation: That is Commander Nkonpa, Yanma Gast.

rows.text: それが、ンコンパ総長、ヤンマ・ガストだ。
rows.translation: That is Commander Nkonpa, Yanma Gast.

35.translation: My name is Himeno Ran, queen of Ishabana.

rows.text: 我が名はイシャバーナの女王ヒメノ・ラン。
rows.translation: My name is Himeno Ran, queen of Ishabana.

36.translation:
• I follow my own selfish path!
• A flower that never falls... Know its nobility!

rows.text: ただ我がままに我が道をゆく!散ることを知らぬ花･･･。 その気高きを知るがよい!
rows.translation: I follow my own selfish path! A flower that never falls... Know its nobility!

37.translation:
• The people are life.
• For the sake of the people, I will get my hands dirty in the mud.

rows.text: 民とは命なり。民のためには、 泥に塗れて手を汚す。
rows.translation: The people are life. For the sake of the people, I will get my hands dirty in the mud.

38.translation: That is the Great Lord of Abundance, Kaguragi Dibouski.

rows.text: それが豊穣の大殿様 カグラギ・ディボウスキ。
rows.translation: That is the Great Lord of Abundance, Kaguragi Dibouski.

39.translation:
• Law is the spear that pierces kings.
• Law is the shield that protects the people.
• For that reason, Gokkan is immovable.

rows.text: 法とは王を穿つ矛。 法とは民を守る盾。 なればこそ、ゴッカンは不動なり。
rows.translation: Law is the spear that pierces kings. Law is the shield that protects the people. For that reason, Gokkan is immovable.

40.translation: Even if the earth splits and the heavens fall, this Rita Kaniska will not be shaken!

rows.text: 地が裂け天が降ろうともこのリタ・カニスカは揺るがない!
rows.translation: Even if the earth splits and the heavens fall, this Rita Kaniska will not be shaken!

41.translation: I am Jeremy Idomonaraku ne Brashieri.

rows.text: 俺は、ジェラミー・イドモナラク・ネ・ブラシエリ。
rows.translation: I am Jeremy Idomonaraku ne Brashieri.

42.translation: The Rift King who rules over humans and Bugnarak and determines the fate of the world,

rows.text: 人、バグナラク、全てを統べて、世界の運命を定める狭間の王様、
rows.translation: The Rift King who rules over humans and Bugnarak and determines the fate of the world,

43.translation: Keep telling the story of what happened forever!

rows.text: その有様を、永久に語り継ぐといい!
rows.translation: Keep telling the story of what happened forever!

44.translation: Be terrified! And tremble! Without any pity or mercy whatsoever, spare not a single tree or blade of grass!

rows.text: 恐怖しろ! そしておののけ! 一切の情け容赦なく一木一草ことごとく!
rows.translation: Be terrified! And tremble! Without any pity or mercy whatsoever, spare not a single tree or blade of grass!

rows.text: 王様戦隊キングオージャー!
俺様たちが世界を支配する!

83.translation: The name of the one who will destroy you is Gira Husty! And...

rows.text: 貴様を討ち滅ぼす者の名はギラ・ハスティー! そして
rows.translation: The name of the one who will destroy you is Gira Husty! And...
